## Fixed

- Support eligible windows owned by a verified embedded helper, using the main application identity for grouping and normal Quit while retaining the native window process for window actions. No application allowlist or additional privacy permissions.
- Include independent, confirmed nonmodal settings dialogs while continuing to exclude modal sheets and floating utility panels.
- Preserve native AX window ownership and reject stale admission results that could hide an already tracked helper window.

## Verification

The complete test suite, constrained-executor checks, WindowLab replays, tooling checks and Apple Silicon Release build pass. Regression tests reproduce the missing-window and command-routing defects; deliberate removal of ownership and dialog safeguards is detected.
